"""Disposable authenticated embedding host; no execution functions are patched."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from fastapi import Request
from fastapi.responses import StreamingResponse
from jvspatial.api import endpoint, get_auth_service
from jvspatial.api.exceptions import AuthenticationError

from jvagent.action.response.streaming import format_sse_chunk
from jvagent.embed import interact_stream

scope = json.loads(Path('/private/tmp/jvagent-native-host-context-smoke/host-scope.json').read_text())

@endpoint('/qualification/embed', methods=['POST'], auth=True, roles=['admin'])
async def embedding_host(request: Request) -> Any:
    bearer = (request.headers.get('authorization') or '').removeprefix('Bearer ')
    principal = await get_auth_service().validate_token(bearer)
    if principal is None:
        raise AuthenticationError(message='Host login is required')
    body = await request.json()
    supplied = body.get('data') or {}
    metadata = {'qualification_host':'native-embed'}
    if 'host_system_context' in supplied:
        metadata.update({k:supplied[k] for k in ('host_system_context','run_id') if k in supplied})

    async def frames():
        async for frame in interact_stream(
            agent_id=scope['agent_id'], user_id=principal.id,
            session_id=body.get('session_id'), utterance=body.get('utterance',''),
            data=metadata,
            is_disconnected=request.is_disconnected,
        ):
            yield format_sse_chunk(frame)

    return StreamingResponse(frames(), media_type='text/event-stream')


async def caller(request: Request):
    bearer=(request.headers.get('authorization') or '').removeprefix('Bearer ')
    principal=await get_auth_service().validate_token(bearer)
    if principal is None:
        raise AuthenticationError(message='Host login is required')
    return principal


@endpoint('/qualification/interview/setup', methods=['POST'], auth=True, roles=['admin'])
async def setup_interview_nonce(request: Request) -> Any:
    from jvagent.core.cache import get_cached_agent
    from jvagent.core.host_context import sign_host_system_context
    principal=await caller(request)
    agent=await get_cached_agent(scope['agent_id'])
    memory=await agent.get_memory()
    _,conversation,uid,sid,_=await memory.get_session(user_id=principal.id,channel='default')
    data=sign_host_system_context('For this platform-state check reply exactly INTERVIEW-PLATFORM-READY.',agent_id=scope['agent_id'],user_id=uid,session_id=sid)
    return {'session_id':sid,'user_id':uid,'data':data}


@endpoint('/qualification/interview/clear', methods=['POST'], auth=True, roles=['admin'])
async def clear_interview_scratch(request: Request) -> Any:
    from jvspatial import flush_deferred_entities
    from jvagent.core.cache import get_cached_agent
    from jvagent.core.host_context import HOST_CONTEXT_REPLAY_KEY
    from jvagent.memory.distributed_conversation_lock import conversation_mutation_lock
    from jvagent.memory.conversation import Conversation
    from jvagent.action.interview.session import clear_interview_context
    principal=await caller(request)
    body=await request.json()
    agent=await get_cached_agent(scope['agent_id'])
    memory=await agent.get_memory()
    conversation=await memory.get_conversation_by_session(body.get('session_id'))
    if conversation is None or conversation.user_id != principal.id:
        raise AuthenticationError(message='Owner session is required')
    async with conversation_mutation_lock(conversation.id):
        conversation=await Conversation.find_one({'id':conversation.id})
        before=len(conversation.context.get(HOST_CONTEXT_REPLAY_KEY,{}))
        conversation.context['interview']={'status':'completed'}
        conversation.context['scratch']='disposable'
        clear_interview_context(conversation)
        await conversation.save()
        await flush_deferred_entities(conversation,strict=True)
    return {'replay_entries_before':before,'replay_entries_after':len(conversation.context.get(HOST_CONTEXT_REPLAY_KEY,{})),'interview_removed':'interview' not in conversation.context,'scratch_removed':'scratch' not in conversation.context}
